clips.title: Setting a concrete house by crane
clips.sourceTitle: Process of Constructing a Concrete Modular House in Just 2 Weeks. PC(Precast Concrete) Factory.
clips.creator: Holy Maker
clips.description: Workers in hard hats and high-visibility vests assemble a house from factory-made concrete parts. A truck-mounted crane lowers concrete wall sections onto a slab, and gloved hands and a steel bar nudge each one into line before it is bolted.
clips.posterAlt: A crane lowers a long concrete beam onto a scaffolded concrete house while workers stand beside it.
clips.license: Copyright Holy Maker, all rights reserved.
clips.changes: Played through YouTube's embedded player, which loads only after you choose to play it. No copy is stored on this website.

clips.title: Steadying a concrete cap by hand
clips.creator: U.S. Navy / Defense VI Records Center
clips.description: A worker in a hard hat rests a gloved hand on a crane-suspended concrete cap and steers it beside a masonry wall as the crane lowers it, then leans over the wall to watch it go down.
clips.license: Public domain in the United States; DVIDS usage conditions apply.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained. Cropped toward the people and the load; the source remains linked.
